safe_manuscript_sentence: To the best of our knowledge, AEGIS-X is the first model-interface-agnostic reliability lifecycle to jointly integrate complementary OOD, uncertainty, and drift evidence with controlled stress/fault probing, associative failure memory, leakage-safe multi-horizon failure prediction, and explicit early warning within a unified experimentally validated framework.
